---
name: a file attic does not read
about: an export that attic did not recognise or read wrongly. structure only, never data.
title: "format: "
labels: format
---

thank you for helping attic read more exports. please do not paste anything from inside your file: no titles, names, times, messages or addresses. only its shape.

**which service and which file**
for example: spotify, `Streaming_History_Audio_2025_0.json`, from the extended streaming history.

**when you downloaded it**
month and year.

**what attic said**
the message it showed, word for word.

**the shape of the file**
on the "what we found" page, press "copy the shape of this file" and paste it here. it has field names, types and counts, never values. please read it before you post it.

```json
paste the shape here
```

**anything else**
for example: the export was in another language, or it came from a work account.
